candidates.description: This vector represents chemical prefixes, suffixes, and terminology related to biochemistry and solution chemistry.
This feature vector represents medical, pharmacological, and clinical trial terminology, particularly terms related to drug dosages, patient treatments, and oncology.
This feature detects medical conditions, neurological terms, and substances related to overdoses, drugs, and bodily harm.
This feature vector represents anatomical body parts, organs, and physiological systems.
This feature vector activates on medical, pharmaceutical, and anatomical terminology, as well as related regulatory and prefix components.
These tokens function as Portuguese articles, prepositions, numbers, and pronouns that frequently indicate grammatical gender, number, and case in noun phrases.
These tokens represent common prefixes used to modify words and indicate scale, relationship, or opposition.
This vector represents adverbial suffixes and adverb-forming morphemes across Romance languages.
This vector represents adverbs and adjectives describing speed, frequency, or the manner of occurrence.
This vector is related to the linguistic tokenization of the letter sequence "ac" across various words and languages.
